insight: Its 'Consensus Meter' summarizes whether a body of papers agrees or disagrees on a question, going beyond surfacing individual citations.
name: Consensus
tagline: AI search over 200M+ peer-reviewed papers, with citations.
description: An academic search engine that runs natural-language questions against a corpus of more than 200 million peer-reviewed papers and synthesizes the findings with inline citations. Its Consensus Meter aggregates how much the studies agree or disagree, and a copilot helps draft literature reviews. Aimed at researchers, students, and clinicians.

modelSupport.notes: LLM synthesis layered over a 200M+ peer-reviewed paper corpus.
